thread:
Noah Kim: Hey everyone, Noah here (platform). First day — trying to get our PR pipeline green but the smoke step needs to flip a staging feature flag. Don’t have Console perms. Who routes staging Console roles?
Teresa Wu: Welcome Noah! :wave: Staging Console role requests go through the access form. For flag flips you typically need `feature_flag_writer` scoped to the staging org.
Noah Kim: Thanks Teresa. Is there a way to avoid asking for a full role? Could we use a scoped token or test flags?
onboard-bot: Hi Noah! Use https://redwood.internal/access-requests and select "Console service account (staging)" for CI tokens. For short-lived CI access choose 30-day expiry.
Omar Farouk: If the test can use `ff-test/*` namespace, that's auto-scoped and doesn't require role escalation. Otherwise we provision a service account and store token in Vault.
Noah Kim: The test flips `canary-serving/v1` currently. I can move it to `ff-test/canary-serving` if that’s acceptable. Any gotchas?
Becky Lin: That should work, but note: `ff-test/*` flags are ephemeral and cleared periodically. If your smoke relies on persisted state across jobs, use a SA instead.
Noah Kim: Good point. For now I'll try `ff-test/canary-serving` and keep the SA request as backup.
Teresa Wu: If you end up requesting SA, include exact job name, flag keys, and intended expiry in the form to speed approvals. Also link your manager for sign-off.
Noah Kim: Will do. Submitted request just now: https://redwood.internal/access-requests/req-2026-602. Justification: "PR smoke needs to toggle staging canary flag to validate rollout". Asked for 30d token.
infra-sre-bot: Draft Vault path created: secret/data/ci/console/sa-2026-602 (awaiting secret upload).
Omar Farouk: I'll take the SA creation after infra uploads the secret. Expect ~48 hours. I'll post the Vault reference and a minimal GHA snippet.
Noah Kim: Appreciate it. I'll switch the smoke to `ff-test/canary-serving` in the meantime and ping here if the SA is required.
Becky Lin: Also FYI: PRs from forks can’t access repo secrets in our GHA setup. If your pipeline runs on forks, gate the flag flip to run only on branch builds from the repo.
Noah Kim: Good catch — we'll gate it. Thanks for the quick help!
Teresa Wu: Welcome aboard! If you want a quick Console flags tour later I can show the admin UI and `ff-test/*` semantics.
Noah Kim: Would love that. 4pm PT works for me.
Omar Farouk: I'll join to cover Vault/GHA integration.
Noah Kim: Awesome — see you then!
